name: ai-council
description: Get parallel code reviews from GPT-4, Grok, Claude, and Gemini - find bugs that single-model reviews miss.

commands.title: AI Council: Review Current File (Power Mode)

ai-council.scriptPath.description: Path to ai_council.py script. Leave empty to use bundled script.

ai-council.apiKeys.openai.description: OpenAI API Key (for GPT-4). Get yours at: https://platform.openai.com/api-keys

ai-council.apiKeys.anthropic.description: Anthropic API Key (for Claude). Get yours at: https://console.anthropic.com/

ai-council.apiKeys.xai.description: xAI API Key (for Grok). Get yours at: https://console.x.ai/

ai-council.apiKeys.google.description: Google API Key (for Gemini - FREE!). Get yours at: https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey

ai-council.apiKeys.groq.description: Groq API Key (for Llama - FREE!). Get yours at: https://console.groq.com/

ai-council.apiKeys.ollama.description: WoW AI auth (user:pass for Basic auth, or Bearer token)

ai-council.ollamaModel.description: Ollama model to use for code review

ai-council.autoReviewOnSave.description: Automatically queue files for review on save

ai-council.showInlineHints.description: Show inline hints for issues at specific line numbers

ai-council.transport.openai.description: OpenAI/GPT auth: api (API key), cli (codex CLI subscription login), or auto (prefer CLI if installed).

ai-council.transport.anthropic.description: Anthropic/Claude auth: api (API key), cli (claude CLI subscription login), or auto (prefer CLI if installed).

ai-council.transport.xai.description: xAI/Grok auth: api (API key), cli (grok CLI subscription login), or auto (prefer CLI if installed).

ai-council.cliModels.anthropic.description: Model for Claude CLI seat (subscription). The claude CLI has no model-listing command, so this is free text, not a picklist - leave blank for Auto, or type an alias your subscription supports (e.g. sonnet, opus, haiku).

ai-council.cliModels.openai.description: Model for Codex/GPT CLI seat (subscription). The codex CLI has no model-listing command, and valid names are gated by ChatGPT account entitlement (a wrong guess fails with 'not supported when using Codex with a ChatGPT account') - leave blank for Auto unless you know a specific model your account supports.

ai-council.cliModels.xai.description: Model for Grok CLI seat (subscription). The extension reads the live list from `grok models` at startup and repopulates this picker; these enum values are only the fallback shown before that completes or if it fails.

ai-council.reviewRubric.description: What the council should look for during a review (layer 2). Leave blank for the built-in default (bugs, security, performance, code quality, architecture). This does NOT replace the permanent integrity rule (layer 1: no manufactured findings, no rubber-stamped consensus) - that always applies and cannot be edited here.
